provenance: Authored public liveness-boundary fixture; no private source or observed response recapture.

contract.timeout: One complete typecheck-timed-out warning in the actual ClientSocket notification, with authored URI/version and all diagnostic fields.
contract.successfulEmpty: An actually completed empty diagnostic future stays successful and empty.
contract.successfulPositive: Complete authored diagnostic payloads pass through without field changes; this unit law does not execute a native checker.
contract.answeredError: A completed backend ResponseError retains its exact code/message and existing fallback classification.
contract.sourceIdentity: The timeout law owns the full authored SFC and actual temporary source URI; only that URI is instantiated in the whole expected envelope.

limitations: A controlled pending future exercises the unchanged outer deadline; it is not a native backend stub or a claim that the SDK ran.
